LanguageData.SCP_008ExposureBody: {PAWN} contracted SCP-008 when infected fluid entered a wound. Isolate the patient. The agent does not spread through air or water.
LanguageData.SCP_008LabBreachBody: The laboratory door has been breached. Three gorehulks and two bulbfreaks have escaped from an experimental compartment. One scientist is already infected with SCP-008. The intact sample is sealed in a separate case.
LanguageData.SCP_008RecoveredBody: The sealed case has reached your colony. Prepare a roofed, cooled laboratory and a containment post before studying it. If safe containment cannot be established, the Foundation will transfer the sample to Site G2.
LanguageData.SCP_008DestroyedBody: The only surviving SCP-008 sample at the GOC facility has been destroyed. The Foundation confirms no viable material remains in the laboratory.
LanguageData.SCP_008BioLabRequirement: Powered decontamination unit in the same laboratory
LanguageData.SCP_008TransferWarningBody: The Foundation allows five days to establish safe containment and research conditions for SCP-008. Otherwise it will transfer the sample to Site G2.
LanguageData.SCP_008TransferredBody: The preparation deadline has passed. The Foundation has moved SCP-008 to Site G2 because safe containment was not established.
LanguageData.SCP_008QuestOffered: The SCP-008 recovery quest is available.
LanguageData.SCP_008QuestUnavailable: Could not offer the SCP-008 quest. Check Anomaly, the SCP-650 encounter, and Foundation contact.
LanguageData.SCP_008DebugCaseSpawned: The SCP-008 case was placed near the selected cell.
LanguageData.SCP_008ObservedReport: The initial inspection confirms a viable SCP-008 sample in the sealed case. No airborne or waterborne transmission has been observed.
LanguageData.SCP_008PartialReport: Infected fluid entering a wound or mucous membrane causes rapidly progressing neurological damage. Safe handling requires cooling, sealed protective clothing and decontamination.
LanguageData.SCP_008DocumentedReport: Research confirms contact transmission and lethal disease progression. SCP-500 removes the infection. The GOC flesh experiments are not a normal effect of SCP-008.
